Name: Leah's Wooden Masterpiece
Author: NoodleJubblies
Description:
This mod does one thing and one thing really well. It replaces Leah's weird twisted statue with, quite literally, [b]a wooden carving of herself nude[/b] ([i]no intricate details[/i]).

So now, instead of her "feeling towards the farmer" being a twisted knot of confusion that you'll either stick in a chest and forget about or put it outside her house to remind her of how [b]you[/b] feel about [b]her[/b], display a simplified statue of the beautiful craftswoman with [i]pride. [/i]Put it on your doorstep. Put it beside your bed. Who cares? It's yours now, and it's most definitely a carving of Leah.

Simply unzip into your mods folder and you're good to go.
